correctness.rationale: An exact finite short-rod generating function yields boundary constant -s(1-p_s); classical gap-sum identities and a uniform O(log k/k²) gap bound give the staged decomposition. value.rationale: The result quantitatively resolves the rate and direction of convergence for every fixed secondary rod length in a natural two-stage adsorption process; the previously known limit alone gives neither. The distinct finite-short-rod boundary penalty is structural and may guide continuum approximations and the open all-k monotonicity question.
